name: Dark chocolate pistachio pecan nut bar
ingredientsText: Pistachios, peanuts, pecans, tapioca fiber, chicory root fiber, sugar, unsweetened chocolate, brown rice flour, honey, brown rice syrup, cocoa butter, milkfat, salt, sunflower lecithin, soy lecithin, natural flavors.
notes: Milkfat is milk. Both sunflower and soy lecithin are listed; the soy one makes soy contains. No Contains line.
